    Help

    How to play

    • Tap a lane as its gem reaches the line. Two thumbs work best. Easy uses three lanes.
    • Hold sustains until the tail runs out. Miss a note and the lead cuts out until you hit again.
    • Whammy a held sustain by wiggling that finger side to side (or moving the mouse). The tail’s twist swings wider the more you wiggle, and whammying an Overdrive sustain tops up your meter.
    • Your score and stars sit right by the highway. Each star fills from the bottom up as you earn it, and after five they fill again in gold. Five stars takes nearly a full combo; gold takes about 98% of the best score Overdrive allows, so a full combo with Overdrive used well. Solo bonuses add to your score but not your stars.
    • Clear every white gem in a phrase to charge Overdrive. The meter sits under the strikeline: when it glows, flick a finger up the screen (or tap Overdrive) for double points. Gold runs up the rails while it lasts.
    • Arrow gems are lifts, the up-strums in fast strumming: lift your finger off the lane as one crosses the line, or tap it again. Fast repeats in one lane alternate tap, lift, tap, lift.
    • The highway turns blue for a solo. Every solo note you hit adds a bonus, and a perfect solo pays half again.
    • Every 10 notes in a row raises your multiplier, shown in the ring under the strikeline. At the top multiplier the rails light up electric blue.
    The modes
    • Quick Play: any song on any difficulty, or add your own audio or Rock Band chart from the end of the setlist.
    • Tour: seven gigs on one life meter, each with a goal and stage conditions. Spend cash on gear between shows.
    • Backstage: the same tour, but your boosts come from gear packs: guitars, amps and pedals in four sets, from Common up to the very rare red Mythic. Fame and your Vault carry over to the next tour.
    • Co-op band: pick Co-op band in Tour or Backstage to play the tour together online, each on your own phone. Every gig is a band challenge (Tag Team, Unison, Overdrive Together, Band Streak or Frontman), and the whole band shares one life meter. Overdrive stacks: each bandmate in Overdrive adds ×2 for everyone. In a unison phrase the highway glows violet: every bandmate has to hit every ringed note.
    • Rock Band charts (beta): load a Rock Band custom (CON file) and play its guitar part on a real guitar controller with strums, hammer-ons, chords, sustains, Overdrive, solos and a rock meter. Run controller setup once if your guitar isn’t recognized. Its own Tour and Backstage build seven-gig tours from your Rock Band songs, on any part (Gamepad included), solo or as a band.
    • On a controller: the D-pad or left stick (or a guitar's strum bar) moves around every screen, A or green presses, B or red goes back, the bumpers switch tabs and the right stick scrolls. In Quick Play the D-pad, face buttons and triggers play the lanes (a guitar plays them on its frets), Back or a stick click deploys Overdrive and Start pauses.
    • Locker: finishing tour gigs earns Tickets. Spend them on skin crates for new highways, notes and hit effects, from Common to Legendary.

    No sound on an iPhone? Flip the silent switch off and turn the volume up.

    Bluetooth headphones play sound late. Calibrate with them on before your first song (Settings), and fine-tune from the pause menu if notes still feel off.

    Options

    Settings

    Timing
    CalibrateTap along to clicks. Run it again whenever you switch headphones
    Timing offsetRaise it if your hits feel late +0 ms
    Note speedHigher is faster and denser on screen 5
    Sound
    Menu musicPlays on the title screen and in the menus 6
    Lead guitarVolume of the lead part in built-in songs. It also cuts out when you miss 7
    Note sounds“With notes” plays each sound in time with the music, so it stays in sync over Bluetooth
    Sound timingMoves the note sounds earlier or later against the music +0 ms
    Display
    Frame rateFrames per second, up to 240 or Max. Your screen’s refresh rate is the real ceiling. Lower saves battery 60
    VSyncDraws in step with your screen’s refresh so notes scroll evenly
    Hit effectsFlames, sparks and particles when you hit notes, and sustains that twist as you whammy
    Extra motionTransitions between screens and modes, the song intro and menu animations. Off makes screens switch instantly
    Highway lengthShorter reads flatter and gives Brutal less room to hide notes
    Swipe up for OverdriveFlick any finger up the screen to deploy, so you don’t have to look for the button
    Bandmates’ highwaysIn co-op, show a small live highway for each bandmate. On a tall portrait highway there’s no room, so pick Medium or Short

    Calibrate timing

    Put on the headphones you play with. You'll hear four count-in clicks, then sixteen more: tap the pad on each of the sixteen. Go by the sound, not the ring. Bluetooth headphones lag, so the ring may pulse before you hear the click.
